caseName: While I Was Waiting for Him
title: Erin & Adam

questions.text: He's alive. I've been picturing him at the bottom of a drop all morning and he's alive... So where was he walking to? Don't soften it, please.
questions.hint: Open the calendar and look between yesterday and today for what Adam had planned.

questions.text: Long Valley. We walked past that station together at lunch yesterday... and he went back down to it on his own, in the dark. What for?
questions.hint: Open the notes to find what Adam needs to do in Long Valley

questions.text: Renee. He's never once said that name to me. I don't know who she is or what she does — can you find that out for me, please?
questions.hint: Open a conversation with Renee to find her position

questions.text: He bought a single. He stood at that window and paid for himself and not for me... What was he in such a hurry to get to today?
questions.hint: Check his card transactions from the past few weeks for a large payment - see what it was for.

questions.text: A plane. He's getting on a plane while I'm up here shouting his name into a valley... What time does it leave? Please.
questions.hint: Unlock the hidden photo gallery to find info about the plane ticket. The code is hidden in Adam's Notes

questions.text: Quarter past one. I couldn't get down there in time if I ran the whole way, and he knew that... How long has he been planning this?
questions.hint: Open a discussion with his brother (Khouya) to discover since when Adam planned to leave

questions.text: Over two weeks. He watched me buy boots for this trip and said nothing... Why did he do this? Whatever reason he gave anyone, I want it.
questions.hint: Open a conversation with his father (Sidi) to find the reason for Adam's departure

onboarding.text: Hi... I'm Erin. I'm sorry to do this to a stranger, but there's nobody else up here. My phone died on our second day and something has gone very wrong.
onboarding.label: Erin

onboarding.text: Adam is my fiancé. Three days out on the San Jacinto range — the whole trip was my surprise for him. He's an accountant, he plans everything, and I thought that made us safe.
onboarding.label: Erin & Adam

onboarding.text: I woke this morning and his half of the tent was cold. His pack is still there. His phone was lying on the groundsheet... he would never leave that behind. Not ever.
onboarding.label: Adam

onboarding.text: I've shouted into that valley until my voice went. Nothing comes back. I'm frightened and I can't sit here guessing any more... Please go through his phone and tell me what you find.
onboarding.label: Erin

notes.title: Training split
notes.body:
Weekly split:
Mon - chest, triceps
Wed - back, biceps
Fri - legs, shoulders
Cardio 20 minutes each session
Protein right after

notes.title: Darija words to remember
notes.body:
contabilità = accounting
escursione in montagna = mountain hiking
fine giornata = end of the work day
onesto = straight, honest
mi manchi = I miss you

notes.title: Yemma's msemen recipe
notes.body:
Fine semolina: 300g
Strong flour: 200g
Salt: 1 tsp
Warm water, enough for the dough to come together
Oil and softened butter for the folding
Let it rest 20 min, then flatten and fold each ball
Dry pan, good and hot, a few minutes each side
